question: With reference to Indus Valley Civilization, the evidence of a ploughed field was found at which of the following sites:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalibangan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Indus Sites**

 
 
 
**Features**

 
 
 

 
 
Lothal

 
 
 
 
• Evidence of double burial
 
• Remains of Rice Husk
 
• Evidence of terracotta figurine of a horse
 
• Dockyard
 
• Terracotta model of a ship 
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Kalibangan **

 
 
 
 
• Evidence of furrowed land
 
• Evidence of wooden furrow
 
• Evidence of seven fire altars
 
• **Ploughed field surface**
 
 
 
 

 
 
Mohenjodaro

 
 
 
 
• Great bath
 
• Great granary
 
• Assembly hall
 
• Steatite image of a bearded man
 
• Seal of Pashupati
 
• Bronze Dancing Girl
 
 
 
 

 Harappa
 
 
 
• Cemeteries
 
• Evidence Of Coffin Burial
 
• Granary outside the fort.
